programme.title: Geheime Unterwelten der SS
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Die Jagd nach dem Nazi-SchatzDie größte Suche nach einem Nazi-Schatz seit dem Zweiten Weltkrieg blieb bislang unbekannt. Mehrere Partner machten sich Ende der 1980-er Jahren auf die Suche nach unterirdischen Einlagerungen im Wert von angeblich 28 Milliarden Dollar.

programme.title: Natur macht Geschichte
programme.desc: HimmelskörperDie Faszination für die Gestirne ist wohl so alt wie die Menschheit selbst, weswegen Menschen ihr Handeln nach ihnen ausrichten. Ihre gigantische Zerstörungsmacht erkennen Naturwissenschaftler allerdings erst in den vergangenen Jahrzehnten.

programme.title: Natur macht Geschichte
programme.desc: S1 E4 — FeuerFeuer ist das Element, das die Menschen am meisten fürchten. Kein Verbot wird so häufig ausgesprochen wie: Du sollst nicht mit dem Feuer spielen! Ganz gleich, ob die Feuerwehr ausrückt, um Keller auszupumpen oder Türen zu öffnen - beim Klang der Sirenen hat jeder zunächst das Bild eines brennenden Hauses im Kopf. Berichte von Flächenbränden in Kalifornien, Australien oder rund ums Mittelmeer verstärken die Angst vor dem Feuer als zerstörerische Kraft.

programme.title: Natur macht Geschichte
programme.desc: S1 E2 — WasserDas Vorhandensein von Wasser legt selbst heute noch fest, wo Menschen leben können und wo nicht. Betrachtet man die Erde vom Weltall aus, so scheint es reichlich Wasser zu geben. Drei Viertel der Erdoberfläche sind von diesem Element bedeckt, es verleiht dem Planeten seine charakteristische blaue Farbe. Die größte Menge ist für den Menschen bislang jedoch völlig nutzlos.

programme.title: Natur macht Geschichte
programme.desc: S1 E1 — ErdeKein Metall regt die Fantasie des Menschen so an wie Gold, trotzdem beeinflusste ein anderes Geschenk der Erde die Entstehung von frühen Hochkulturen viel stärker: Kupfer. Aus Kupfer und Zinn stellten unsere Vorfahren Bronze her. Und mit energiereicheren Brennmaterialien gelang es vor 3.000 Jahren schließlich Eisen zu schmelzen.

programme.title: Natur macht Geschichte
programme.desc: S1 E3 — LuftWind scheint etwas völlig Chaotisches zu sein. Betrachtet man seine Bewegungen jedoch aus einer globalen Perspektive, erkennt man, dass bestimmte Windsysteme konstanten Routen rund um den Globus folgen. Diese regelmäßigen Luftbewegungen sind für zahlreiche klimatische Besonderheiten verantwortlich. Beispielsweise lassen bestimmte Windsysteme Wüsten entstehen, indem sie die Feuchtigkeit einer Region kontinuierlich in eine andere Weltgegend transportieren.

programme.title: Natur macht Geschichte
programme.desc: MikrobenMikroben erfüllen wichtige Aufgaben in Ökosystemen und bestimmen, wie der Mensch sich ernährt. Einige haben aber das Potenzial, die Zivilisation um Jahrhunderte zurückzuwerfen, weswegen die Medizin zum Wettlauf zwischen Mensch und Mikrobe wird.

programme.title: Reise ins Innere der Erde - Auf den Spuren von Jules Verne
programme.desc: Jules Verne schickt seine Helden 1864 auf eine sagenhafte Reise zum Mittelpunkt der Erde. Heute folgen Forscher diesem Weg und zeigen die Überraschungen wie bizarre Kristalle und unbekannte Lebensformen, die die echte Reise ins Erdinnere bereithält.

programme.title: Die Erde - Unruhiger Planet
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation zeigt die Geschichte der Erde von ihrer Entstehung bis heute. Wissenschaftler erforschen an geologischen Hotspots, wie sich die Erde verändert. Solche Hotspots können unter Kontinenten, aber auch unter dem Meeresboden liegen.

programme.title: Geheimnisvolles Universum
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Schwarze LöcherEs steht eines der faszinierendsten und zugleich rätselhaftesten Phänomene der modernen Astrophysik im Mittelpunkt: Schwarze Löcher. Was verbirgt sich hinter diesen kosmischen Phänomenen, die unser Verständnis von Raum und Zeit auf die Probe stellen.

programme.title: Geheimnisvolles Universum
programme.desc: S1 E3 — SupernovaeSupernovae sind zugleich zerstörerisch und schöpferisch. Sie erschaffen neue Welten, verraten Geheimnisse kosmischer Zyklen und stellen die moderne Astronomie vor Rätsel. Der Film erzählt, wie aus Zerstörung neues Leben im Sternenhimmel entsteht.

programme.title: Geheimnisvolles Universum
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Dunkle KräfteDunkle Materie und Dunkle Energie gehören zu den größten Rätseln der modernen Kosmologie. Sie beeinflussen die Bewegung von Galaxien und die Ausdehnung des Universums und sind für unsere Augen unsichtbar. Doch wie spürt man die dunklen Kräfte auf.

programme.title: Geheimnisvolles Universum
programme.desc: S1 E8 — GalaxienGalaxien erzählen die Geschichte unseres Universums – von seiner Entstehung bis zur heutigen Struktur. Forscher analysieren die ältesten Sterne und galaktische Fossilien und stellen sich die Frage: Was passiert mit der Milchstraße in ferner Zukunft.

programme.title: Geheimnisvolles Universum
programme.desc: S1 E4 — LebensbausteineVor Milliarden Jahren entstand auf der Erde etwas Einzigartiges: Leben. Doch wie konnten aus toter Materie Organismen entstehen? Das ist eines der größten Geheimnisse der Wissenschaft, dem in dieser Folge nachgegangen wird.

programme.title: Geheimnisvolles Universum

programme.title: Kin
programme.desc: Best Telenovela - National Winner Asian Academy Creative Awards (2020) | Kin is a drama about the complexities of life, love and family relationships. Years have passed since Yoke and Ella had their lives turned upside-down when they returned to be with their rightful families after having been swapped at birth. Years later, Yoke has seemingly embraced her role as a status-conscious, high society Shelley, assuming a leadership role in the family business. Ella has accepted her fate as a member of the salt of the earth, working-class Loh family but struggles to make something of her life. Has the nature vs nurture battle run its course or are relationships between the families still as fraught and complicated as ever? The Lohs, Shelleys, Hassans, and Balas have overcome personal loss, incarceration, as well as estrangement of their loved ones; yet lingering tensions remain. Mysteries continue to unfold as characters pursue their individual agendas, while emotional drama abounds as surprising twists are revealed that threaten the stability to which they have become accustomed..

programme.title: Luke Nguyen’s India
programme.desc: Luke Nguyen's India takes viewers on a journey of the senses through India where food, religion, and rich culture go hand in hand. In the brand new series, Luke circumnavigates Southern India discovering the cuisines, sounds, and colours of this captivating region. Immersing himself in India's spices, ancient traditions, and unique locations, Luke gets to know local cooks and chefs', experts and loveable characters who introduce him to the wonderful world of Indian cuisine. With breathtaking mountain backdrops to small towns, hectic cities and sacred waterways, Luke in his unique and respectful style will dive head-long into the diverse and colourful society that is India.

programme.title: Let Me Tell You A Story
programme.desc: Relive the past through our oldest living historians, vividly brought to life through memories, animation, reenactments and archives. This generation of people witnessed life in the country before there was a nation and can still remember glimpses of a Singapore that we barely see traces of today. What was it like living in a bustling colonial city-state of immigrants, filled with colorful communities and languages? Or growing up in a time of kampungs and crowded urban squatter areas, where spitting was common and cattle still roamed the streets? From the stirring to the humorous, their recollections chronicle the personal coming-of-age of an entire generation born before WWII, and reveal intriguing insights from a vastly different era of Singapore.

programme.title: Kin

Years have passed since Yoke and Ella had their lives turned upside-down when they returned to be with their rightful families after having been swapped at birth. Years later, Yoke has seemingly embraced her role as a status-conscious, high society Shelley, assuming a leadership role in the family business. The Lohs, Shelleys, Hassans, and Balas have overcome personal loss, incarceration, as well as estrangement of their loved ones; yet lingering tensions remain. Mysteries continue to unfold as characters pursue their individual agendas, while emotional drama abounds as surprising twists are revealed that threaten the stability to which they have become accustomed..

programme.title: Big Biz Duel

programme.title: (Live) Hello Singapore
programme.desc: Delivering the day's latest news and social features that matter to you. Every Monday to Friday, from 6.30pm to 7.30pm on Channel 8.

programme.title: Unchained Medley
programme.desc: Haunted by nightmares and a plagiarism scandal, music producer Ding Yat Chun retreats to a quiet village, where he accidentally frees the spirit of a 1990s Cantonese opera star. As he helps her recover her memories and uncover the truth behind her mysterious death, friendship turns to love—while a hidden enemy will do anything to keep the past buried. 流行音乐制作人丁一骏长期饱受噩梦困扰，更卷入抄袭丑闻，遂搬到一座小村暂住散心。一次偶然，他打开村屋里的粤剧戏服旧箱，意外释放了花旦云柳芳的灵魂。柳芳原是90年代的粤剧花旦，却因意外离世，并失去了大部分生前记忆，只想寻找昔日恋人曲行云。一骏决定帮助她完成心愿，他们两阴阳相隔在相处中互相扶持，渐生情愫。然而，当有人得知柳芳的鬼魂仍在人间，担心她的死亡真相曝光，竟不惜一切代价掩盖秘密……

programme.title: Heart of Justice
programme.desc: What really shapes a court judgment beyond what we see in the courtroom? Through some of Singapore’s most pivotal and talked-about cases, Heart of Justice takes viewers from crime to conviction, to uncover critical decisions that determine the final outcome. The series offers a rare insight into how Singapore’s justice system works, revealing why justice is rarely as straightforward as it seems. ​新加坡的司法体系在国际上享有极高信誉，但对一般民众而言，在法槌落下之前，审判背后究竟发生了什么？全新资讯节目《法正之心》以前所未有的视角，深入本地曾引发广泛关注的重要案件，带领观众重新审视每宗案件的发展过程，了解司法制度如何运作，以及正义如何得以实现。

programme.title: Tuesday Report : Ah MaDe with Love
programme.desc: Some Ah Mas guard old flavours while others play with new ones. From Hakka Lei Cha to Teochew Kway Chap and Nyonya Satay, their recipes live in their heads. At the stove, grandchildren learn to cook and discover the hardships behind each dish. One Ah Ma adds dark chocolate to rendang, another is losing her memory. As long as someone learns, what Ah Ma made with love lives on. 灶台前的阿嫲，有的守着老味道，有的玩出新花样。客家擂茶、潮州粿汁、娘惹沙爹，食谱多半记在脑里，调味全凭感觉。孙辈走进厨房，学手艺，也看见阿嫲熬过的苦日子。有人把黑巧克力加进仁当，有人已快想不起拿手菜。只要还有人愿意学，味道就不会失传。《那些阿嫲教会我的菜》，教会我们的不只是菜。

programme.title: The Leftovers
programme.desc: In 2037, a volcanic eruption devastates Equaland, causing widespread organ failure and fuelling an illegal organ trade. Desperate to fund his mother's lung transplant, Lin Zhekang enters underground boxing and crosses paths with compassionate doctor Ren Xin. When her sister and his mother are abducted by organ trafficking syndicate Straits Hall, they join forces with a police officer and syndicate insider to rescue them. Meanwhile, disgraced scientist Xiao Wenze seeks a crucial research sample, Zeta, from Zhekang's mother to revive his experiments in lab-grown organs. As their rescue mission unfolds, Equaland's supervolcano erupts again, plunging the island into chaos. 2037年，虚构的赤岛国因火山活动导致严重污染，器官衰竭病例激增，非法器官买卖猖獗。贫民窟青年林喆康为筹钱替母亲林爱琴换肺，不惜打黑拳，并结识女医生任心。随后，任心的妹妹及林爱琴相继遭器官贩卖集团「海峡堂」绑架。喆康与任心联手警察高尚及车手张三展开营救。与此同时，落魄医生萧文泽企图利用林爱琴掌握的神秘研究样本「Zeta」，重启人造器官研究，并答应保护喆康。正当众人展开救援行动，赤岛国的超级火山再次爆发，全国陷入紧急状态……

programme.title: (Live) News Tonight
programme.desc: Daily evening updates on top local news and world news.

programme.title: Health Express
programme.sub-title: Cooking Oil, Breast Cancer and Strabismus Detection
programme.desc: Could using the wrong cooking oil affect breast cancer risk? This episode examines the relationship between cooking oils and health, addressing common concerns about dietary choices. Experts also introduce a simple flashlight test to help identify possible signs of strabismus, or crossed eyes.

programme.title: The Glory
programme.desc: Abandoned as a child, Zhuang Han Yan grows up in the southern countryside before returning to her family in the capital. She catches the eye of Fu Yun Xi, a deputy minister with a mysterious illness, who sees her as an ideal wife. As they navigate their relationship, they fall in love, and Han Yan reconnects with her mother while finding warmth and belonging with the Fu family.

programme.title: Lost You Forever
programme.desc: Cang Xuan managed to overcome the suppression and schemes of his fifth and seventh uncles and successfully ascended to the throne of the Western Yan Kingdom. In order to help Cang Xuan with his grand ambitions, Xiao Yao planned to rely on the unity of the Central Plains clans to assist Cang Xuan, and arranged a marriage alliance with Chi Shui Feng Long.

programme.title: James' Going Places VI
programme.desc: "James Going Places" focuses on finding the menu of James' private kitchen. In order to find delicious dishes that he remembers, James will bring viewers to explore every corners that has tasty delicacies and culinary expertise. In the program, we will show the processing methods of special ingredients, try new sauces or new cooking methods, make creative dishes (cooking teaching), and finally a "James creative cuisine".

programme.title: Baby Blues
programme.desc: 安哥蛋店的老板叫陈安,大家都叫他Uncle Tan. 陈安的老婆杨水莲精明能干,管理着店里的大小事情,陈安对老婆唯唯喏喏.店里唯一的伙计阿亮也怕这个老板娘三分.陈巧花是陈安的大女儿,也是陈安的得力帮手,性格内向,不施脂粉,每天只会埋首工作,38岁了仍嫁杏无期,因此非常不得水莲的宠爱. 蛋店的生意不错.每天,巧花就会第一个到蛋店开门,准备把蛋送到各个订户去.这时,在巴刹卖蛋的刘凤萍总会跑来,在蛋堆里东挑西选的大作记号,好让巧花把最大最新鲜的鸡蛋留给她。水莲最讨厌凤萍趁她不在的时候偷偷来选蛋.两人虽有生意上的往来,但也势如水火. 巧云是巧花的妹妹,姐妹俩相差十几岁.风华正茂，走在时代前端的巧云活泼好动,不喜欢朝九晚五的生活,当导游是她最终的目标.偏偏在导游考试那天却误了时间,幸水莲飞车载送她到考场,她才能顺利的参加考试. 水莲和巧花送蛋到巴刹,凤萍发现鸡蛋上没有自己作的记号,就和水莲起了争执,两人争吵时,水莲的手机跌坏,要凤萍赔钱,凤萍赶着去接儿子海深出狱,无奈赔了水莲一百块. 水莲买了新手机,到处向人炫耀,不料被抢,海深经过,帮水莲抢回手机,让巧花对他留下好印象. 海深出狱回家.发现到屋里屋外都挂满了黄丝带.小外甥女欣仪告诉他黄丝带的故事,表示欢迎他回家.海深为欣仪的细腻心思感动不已…… 巧云夜归,巧花不放心到楼下等她,不料却被巧云当色郎打.巧花额头肿起了一大块，巧云以粉底帮她掩饰。不巧隔天出了小意外，海深以为是自己用花瓶伤了巧花，就急急拿熟鸡蛋为巧花搓揉。巧花和海深近距离接触，一颗心简直就如小鹿乱撞 ....

programme.title: 100% Wife
programme.desc: Three generations of the Jin family live under one roof. Mrs. Jin-Ke mei-man has two sons, You-Tsai and You-De. You-Tsai abandoned the family many years ago, leaving his wife Siou-Ying to shoulder the huge responsibility of the Jin family business selling fish products at market. programme.title: Big Biz Duel

programme.title: Big Biz Duel
programme.desc: Zhao Kai intends to give 20% of his shares to the employees, a move opposed by Dao Ming. He challenges Dao Ming, agreeing to revoke the decision if a pen cannot be delivered from Qianhai to Pei Hua in Harbin before midnight.

programme.title: Golden City
programme.desc: This drama is set in the Jiufen area from the 1960s to the 1970s. It tells the story of how three brothers conquered the world with their bare hands. Through the love story of the previous generation, it connects the common emotions between the two generations depicting the memories and in-depth exploration of the differences in values between them. 本剧以1960年代至1970年代的九份地区为背景，述说三个拜把兄弟如何赤手空拳打天下，藉由上一代的爱情故事串连与第二代之间共同的情感与记忆，深度探索两代之间的价值观差异。

programme.title: Unchained Medley
programme.desc: Haunted by nightmares and a plagiarism scandal, music producer Ding Yat Chun retreats to a quiet village, where he accidentally frees the spirit of a 1990s Cantonese opera star. As he helps her recover her memories and uncover the truth behind her mysterious death, friendship turns to love—while a hidden enemy will do anything to keep the past buried. 流行音乐制作人丁一骏长期饱受噩梦困扰，更卷入抄袭丑闻，遂搬到一座小村暂住散心。一次偶然，他打开村屋里的粤剧戏服旧箱，意外释放了花旦云柳芳的灵魂。柳芳原是90年代的粤剧花旦，却因意外离世，并失去了大部分生前记忆，只想寻找昔日恋人曲行云。一骏决定帮助她完成心愿，他们两阴阳相隔在相处中互相扶持，渐生情愫。然而，当有人得知柳芳的鬼魂仍在人间，担心她的死亡真相曝光，竟不惜一切代价掩盖秘密……

programme.title: King of Culinary: Woks Up
programme.desc: It’s time for the Team Relay! For the first time, the leaders and hawkers must take turns to complete two versions of Bak Chor Mee, including a creative cold version. Will it surprise or shock the judges? Can Mei Rong draw on her family’s 100-year-old traditional recipe to impress the judges and help Dylan’s team score the final win before the Grand Finale?

programme.title: The Leftovers
programme.desc: In 2037, a volcanic eruption devastates Equaland, causing widespread organ failure and fuelling an illegal organ trade. Desperate to fund his mother's lung transplant, Lin Zhekang enters underground boxing and crosses paths with compassionate doctor Ren Xin. When her sister and his mother are abducted by organ trafficking syndicate Straits Hall, they join forces with a police officer and syndicate insider to rescue them. Meanwhile, disgraced scientist Xiao Wenze seeks a crucial research sample, Zeta, from Zhekang's mother to revive his experiments in lab-grown organs. As their rescue mission unfolds, Equaland's supervolcano erupts again, plunging the island into chaos. 2037年，虚构的赤岛国因火山活动导致严重污染，器官衰竭病例激增，非法器官买卖猖獗。贫民窟青年林喆康为筹钱替母亲林爱琴换肺，不惜打黑拳，并结识女医生任心。随后，任心的妹妹及林爱琴相继遭器官贩卖集团「海峡堂」绑架。喆康与任心联手警察高尚及车手张三展开营救。与此同时，落魄医生萧文泽企图利用林爱琴掌握的神秘研究样本「Zeta」，重启人造器官研究，并答应保护喆康。正当众人展开救援行动，赤岛国的超级火山再次爆发，全国陷入紧急状态……

As they navigate their relationship, they fall in love, and Han Yan reconnects with her mother while finding warmth and belonging with the Fu family.

programme.title: 100% Wife
programme.desc: Three generations of the Jin family live under one roof. Mrs. Jin-Ke mei-man has two sons, You-Tsai and You-De. You-Tsai abandoned the family many years ago, leaving his wife Siou-Ying to shoulder the huge responsibility of the Jin family business selling fish products at market. Although Siou-Ying was betrayed by You-Tsai, she has still been a dutiful daughter to her mother-in-law, and has single-mindedly raised four children. 三代同堂的金家，奶奶金柯美满，膝下有两子-有财跟有德。有财早年抛弃家庭离开，妻子秀英一肩扛下金家重责大任，在市场从事贩卖鱼货的工作。虽然有财对不起秀英在先，但秀英仍然孝顺婆婆，也拉拔彦钧等四个孩子长大。透过金家的故事，除了体会婚姻的酸与甜，还得面对婆媳、姑嫂、妯娌间的「那些小事」…，也透视到家庭与爱情真正爱的真谛！

As he helps her recover her memories and uncover the truth behind her mysterious death, friendship turns to love—while a hidden enemy will do anything to keep the past buried. 流行音乐制作人丁一骏长期饱受噩梦困扰，更卷入抄袭丑闻，遂搬到一座小村暂住散心。一次偶然，他打开村屋里的粤剧戏服旧箱，意外释放了花旦云柳芳的灵魂。柳芳原是90年代的粤剧花旦，却因意外离世，并失去了大部分生前记忆，只想寻找昔日恋人曲行云。一骏决定帮助她完成心愿，他们两阴阳相隔在相处中互相扶持，渐生情愫。然而，当有人得知柳芳的鬼魂仍在人间，担心她的死亡真相曝光，竟不惜一切代价掩盖秘密……

programme.title: House Everything
programme.desc: After losing her husband, Yulan took on the responsibility of supporting her family. At the same time, she kept one of his favourite traditions — making dried tangerine peels. Each piece holds a memory of him, but over time, they have taken over the kitchen, leaving her son reluctant to step inside. Can the team transform the kitchen into a warm space where mother and son can truly feel at home?

programme.title: The Leftovers
programme.desc: In 2037, a volcanic eruption devastates Equaland, causing widespread organ failure and fuelling an illegal organ trade. Desperate to fund his mother's lung transplant, Lin Zhekang enters underground boxing and crosses paths with compassionate doctor Ren Xin. When her sister and his mother are abducted by organ trafficking syndicate Straits Hall, they join forces with a police officer and syndicate insider to rescue them. Meanwhile, disgraced scientist Xiao Wenze seeks a crucial research sample, Zeta, from Zhekang's mother to revive his experiments in lab-grown organs. As their rescue mission unfolds, Equaland's supervolcano erupts again, plunging the island into chaos. 2037年，虚构的赤岛国因火山活动导致严重污染，器官衰竭病例激增，非法器官买卖猖獗。贫民窟青年林喆康为筹钱替母亲林爱琴换肺，不惜打黑拳，并结识女医生任心。随后，任心的妹妹及林爱琴相继遭器官贩卖集团「海峡堂」绑架。喆康与任心联手警察高尚及车手张三展开营救。与此同时，落魄医生萧文泽企图利用林爱琴掌握的神秘研究样本「Zeta」，重启人造器官研究，并答应保护喆康。正当众人展开救援行动，赤岛国的超级火山再次爆发，全国陷入紧急状态……

programme.title: Foodie Trio
programme.desc: Do youngsters like traditional cuisine? Are the older generation resistant to trendy dishes? Do kids only eat fast food? To dispel these misconceptions, 3 hosts from different age groups will go on a nationwide culinary journey in a van, bringing them closer through food. An ingredient each episode, guiding viewers to explore a variety of traditional food, creative dishes, and kid-friendly treats!新一代年轻人不爱吃传统美食？老一辈年长者无法接受潮流料理？小孩只爱汉堡薯条？为了打破迷思，三位不同年龄层的主持人，将乘坐古董面包车，走访全国寻找美味料理，让美食打破年龄的隔阂，拉近彼此距离！每集将围绕一个主食材，带领大家探索各种不同的传统佳肴、创意料理和童趣美食，三道菜肴都各具特色，势必直击大家的味蕾！

programme.title: Let's Go Flying
programme.desc: Led by popular host Ho Mei, this programme will explore seven major cities in the three major Southeast Asian countries - Malaysia, Thailand and the Philippines, taking the audience on a passionate and mysterious adventure to unlock unknown secrets and cultural charm! 由人气主持人何美，搭配拥有超强综艺感的「四大男神」-谢佳见、陈谦文、杨奇煜及台日混血男星各务孝太领航，乘着亚洲航空四大航线，深入东南亚三大国家——马来西亚、泰国与菲律宾七大城市，带观众展开一场热情又神秘的冒险旅程，解锁不为人知的秘境与文化魅力！

programme.title: Vengeance of the Bride
programme.desc: Yin Zaihe and his son return to Korea. Zaihe asks Jiang Baishan about the fire that killed Rixi and his family ten years ago. Renshun is shocked to learn that Jiang Feng is not her biological daughter. Longzi lies that Jiang Feng was born from Baishan's extramarital affair. Renshun kicks Jiang Feng out of the house.

programme.title: The Love Trap
programme.desc: Khem, an investigator, meets Phitchaya, the suspect in a food poisoning case. Phitchaya runs away when Khem chases after her. Strange things happen and lead to them traveling back to 1913. As they look for a way to get back to the present time, they accidentally become involved in a murder case. 讲述了年轻警官Khemchat正在调查一位著名餐厅老板死因的故事。调查期间，Khemchat跟监了嫌疑犯之一的甜点厨师Pechaya（诺吉拉·叻卡准南衮 饰）。但奇怪的事发生了，因为这次交集，意外让这对夫妇穿越回到1913年... 警官Khemchat不得不同意与Pechaya暂时休战。两人互相帮助，想办法回到他们所处的时代，但一次机缘巧合，让他们卷入了一个富有贵族的家族谋杀案

programme.title: Chasing Lava
programme.desc: Chasing Lava is an epic journey into the world's most spectacular and dangerous volcanoes and the extraordinary people who cannot resist their call. Filmed across three continents, five countries and nine active volcanoes, this breathtaking two-part documentary follows fearless adventurers who venture into the fiery heart of erupting craters and pioneering scientists racing to decipher the warning signs of disaster. From the explosive volcanoes of Vanuatu and Indonesia to Iceland's dramatic landscapes of fire and ice, Ethiopia's otherworldly volcanic wilderness and the restless volcanoes of the Philippines, the series takes viewers to some of Earth's most hostile and awe-inspiring places. Combining spectacular cinematography with intimate human stories, Chasing Lava is a thrilling exploration of courage, obsession, discovery and humanity's enduring fascination with the powerful forces that shape our restless planet.

programme.title: Call Us Wunderkind
programme.desc: What if your child could do what most adults never will? Call Us Wunderkind follows child prodigies across Singapore, Thailand and the Philippines, and the families who have rebuilt their lives around them. But who decides a child is a prodigy? And what does it take to keep one going? Across six episodes, the series counts the time, money and attention poured into a single gift, and asks who really pays. What happens when a child who never fails, does? Where does a prodigy go to just be a kid? When a talent goes viral, who controls the story? And when the applause dies down, who are they without it? With insights from gifted-education experts, psychologists and former prodigies, Call Us Wunderkind takes an intimate look at childhoods lived at full speed, and asks what it really means to grow up extraordinary.

programme.title: Drugs 2.0
programme.desc: The global drug landscape is being reshaped by the fast-moving challenge of new psychoactive substances (NPS) –compounds engineered to replicate the highs of drugs like MDMA, heroin and cannabis. They are constantly evolving and far more unpredictable. Created by modifying the chemical structure of traditional illicit drugs to circumvent drug laws, they can evade routine drug tests, leaving global drug regulators racing to respond. In Singapore, these mostly synthetic drugs remain a small but growing threat. New laws now cover any substance that can produce a psychoactive effect. But as younger users are drawn in by the illusion of safer highs, authorities warn the problem could escalate if left unchecked. CNA follows the trail from clandestine labs in India to Singapore’s forensic labs, where scientists scramble to decode the ever-changing chemistry behind these drugs.

programme.title: Drugs 2.0
programme.desc: The global drug landscape is being reshaped by the fast-moving challenge of new psychoactive substances (NPS) –compounds engineered to replicate the highs of drugs like MDMA, heroin and cannabis. They are constantly evolving and far more unpredictable. Created by modifying the chemical structure of traditional illicit drugs to circumvent drug laws, they can evade routine drug tests, leaving global drug regulators racing to respond. In Singapore, these mostly synthetic drugs remain a small but growing threat. New laws now cover any substance that can produce a psychoactive effect. But as younger users are drawn in by the illusion of safer highs, authorities warn the problem could escalate if left unchecked. CNA follows the trail from clandestine labs in India to Singapore’s forensic labs, where scientists scramble to decode the ever-changing chemistry behind these drugs.

programme.title: Chasing Lava

programme.title: On The Red Dot
programme.sub-title: I Am A Hawker: Bib Gourmand Edition (Ep3): Koh Brother Pig’s Organ Soup
programme.desc: What does it take for everyday hawker stalls to earn Michelin recognition, and can they keep their Bib Gourmand status? How has the accolade impacted the life of these humble hawkers? At Bahrakath Mutton Soup, sole chef Syed Abdul Rahaman grapples with passing down this award-winning taste to his sons as age creeps up on him. Over at Selamat Datang Warong Pak Sapari, second-generation owner Sumadi Sapari walks the tightrope between expanding the business and protecting the authenticity of his late father's recipe. For Koh Brother Pig Organ Soup, Thomas Koh left his career to carry on a family legacy. After failed franchising attempts, he's poured himself into making every bowl the best it can be. And at Chef Kang's Noodle House, brothers Benson and Winson Moo—disciples of Michelin-starred Chef Kang—have won, lost, and regained their Bib Gourmand. This year, the question looms: can they hold onto it?
